one_line: Young Maratha Peshwa who rebuilt state power after Panipat with discipline, reform and hard-fought campaigns.

appearance.age_look: Late teens to early twenties, lean but athletic build with the hint of a lingering illness kept in check by willpower.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp jaw, wheatish complexion, straight nose, slightly arched brows and determined dark brown eyes; a faint tiredness under the eyes contrasts with a calm, composed default expression showing disciplined focus rather than flamboyance.
appearance.hair: Black hair kept short and neat under a deep maroon Maratha-style turban (folded pheta) with a subtle gold border and a single small white feather tucked on the left side.
appearance.costume: A long, knee-length white cotton angarkha (wrap-over robe) with side-tie knots and a soft flare, worn over a fitted light-cream paijama; a rich deep-maroon silk kamarband (waist sash) wraps his midsection with a tucked-in small document pouch; over this, a sleeveless buff-coloured leather-stitched waistcoat with simple stitch lines, suggesting light campaign armour; on his feet are brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes; minimal jewellery: a slim gold chain at the neck, a single small gold ring on the right hand and a simple black-thread amulet on his left wrist, indicating personal austerity despite high status.
appearance.signature: A straight-bladed Maratha shamsheer with a gently curving steel blade and a plain brass hilt, sheathed in a dark brown leather scabbard that hangs from a simple brown leather belt; in his left hand he often holds a rolled scroll sealed with red wax, symbolising his administrative discipline.

ref_desc: Peshwa Madhavrao I is a lean late-teen Maratha with an oval wheatish face and calm dark eyes, wearing a deep-maroon turban, white angarkha, cream paijama, buff leather waistcoat, maroon sash, brown mojari shoes, and carrying a brass-hilted shamsheer with a leather scabbard plus a rolled scroll.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Peshwa Madhavrao I as a dignified young Maratha leader: a lean late-teen with an oval wheatish face, sharp jaw, straight nose, determined dark brown eyes and a calm, composed default expression with a hint of tiredness under the eyes. His black hair is short and neat, mostly hidden by a deep maroon Maratha pheta (turban) with a subtle gold border and a single small white feather on the left. He wears a knee-length white cotton angarkha that wraps across his chest and ties at the side, flaring softly over a fitted light-cream paijama. Around his waist is a rich deep-maroon silk kamarband with a small document pouch tucked into it, and over the angarkha he has a sleeveless buff-coloured leather-stitched waistcoat suggesting light campaign armour. His feet are in brown leather mojari shoes with slightly upturned toes. Jewellery is minimal: a slim gold chain at his neck, a small gold ring on his right hand and a simple black-thread amulet on his left wrist to show personal austerity. At his left hip hangs a straight Maratha shamsheer in a dark brown leather scabbard with a plain brass hilt, and in his left hand he holds a rolled scroll sealed with red wax, while his right hand can rest lightly on the sword hilt; use a palette dominated by deep maroon, white, light cream, buff leather brown and dark brown, and present him in neutral, clear poses to show his face, hair, outfit and weapons from head to toe.
